correctness.rationale: For p clique coordinates, anchor at the uniquely minimal one. These p chambers have unit translation-quotient Jacobians relative to a fixed root. The maximum of the p−1 remaining coordinates has unweighted density (p−1)r^(p−2), and each of the q independent coordinates has an interval of length 2−r. Adding the clique constraints restricts r to at most one. The incomplete beta integral then gives a sum of coefficients (not just a binomial probability); the projection Gram determinant is 1/n. Below half the tail probability tends to one; above half the first coefficient times its limiting geometric sum gives p²/(p−q); in the window the standardized threshold is (p−q−1)/sqrt(n−1) and local Stirling gives the stated Gaussian coefficient. Independent checks used exact polynomial integration for 121 pairs and numerical tight-constraint hulls for (2,2), (2,3), (3,2), with rooted volumes 14/3, 15/2, 11/2 and intrinsic volumes smaller by sqrt(n).
